components.name: WaIcon
components.description:
Icons are scalable vector symbols that represent actions, content, or status throughout your application.
They support Font Awesome and custom icon libraries with animation presets.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the icon to draw. Available names depend on the icon library being used.

attributes.name: family
attributes.description:
The family of icons to choose from. For Font Awesome Free, valid options include `classic` and `brands`. For
Font Awesome Pro subscribers, valid options include, `classic`, `sharp`, `duotone`, `sharp-duotone`, and `brands`.
A valid kit code must be present to show pro icons via CDN. You can set `<html data-fa-kit-code="...">` to provide
one.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description:
The name of the icon's variant. For Font Awesome, valid options include `thin`, `light`, `regular`, and `solid` for
the `classic` and `sharp` families. Some variants require a Font Awesome Pro subscription. Custom icon libraries
may or may not use this property.

attributes.name: canvas
attributes.description:
Sets the icon canvas — the box the icon is centered within. Unset renders as `fixed` (1.25em × 1em); `auto` hugs the
icon's width; `square` is 1.25em × 1.25em; `roomy` is 1.5em × 1.5em. Mirrors Font Awesome's `fa-fixed-width`,
`fa-width-auto`, `fa-canvas-square`, and `fa-canvas-roomy`. Scales with `font-size`.

attributes.name: auto-width
attributes.description: Sets the width of the icon to match the cropped SVG viewBox. This operates like the Font `fa-width-auto` class.

attributes.name: swap-opacity
attributes.description: Swaps the opacity of duotone icons.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description:
An external URL of an SVG file. Be sure you trust the content you are including, as it will be executed as code and
can result in XSS attacks.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
An alternate description to use for assistive devices. If omitted, the icon will be considered presentational and
ignored by assistive devices.

attributes.name: library
attributes.description: The name of a registered custom icon library.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Sets the rotation degree of the icon

attributes.name: flip
attributes.description: Sets the flip direction of the icon along the 'x' (horizontal), 'y' (vertical), or 'both' axes.

attributes.name: animation
attributes.description: Sets the animation for the icon

events.name: wa-load
events.description: Emitted when the icon has loaded. When using `spriteSheet: true` this will not emit.

events.name: wa-error
events.description: Emitted when the icon fails to load due to an error. When using `spriteSheet: true` this will not emit.

cssProperties.name: --animation-delay
cssProperties.description: Sets when the animation will start.

cssProperties.name: --animation-direction
cssProperties.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

cssProperties.name: --animation-duration
cssProperties.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

cssProperties.name: --animation-iteration-count
cssProperties.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played.

cssProperties.name: --animation-timing
cssProperties.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration.

cssProperties.name: --beat-fade-opacity
cssProperties.description: Set lowest opacity value an icon with `beat-fade` animation will fade to and from.

cssProperties.name: --beat-fade-scale
cssProperties.description: Set max value that an icon with `beat-fade` animation will scale.

cssProperties.name: --beat-scale
cssProperties.description: Set the scale multiplier for an icon with `beat` animation. This multiplies the animation's 1.25× base pulse, so the default `1.25` peaks at ~1.56× and `2` roughly doubles the pulse.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-height
cssProperties.description: Set the max height an icon with `bounce` animation will jump to when bouncing.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-jump-scale-x
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s horizontal distortion (“squish”) at the top of the jump.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-jump-scale-y
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s vertical distortion (“squish”) at the top of the jump.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-land-scale-x
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s horizontal distortion (“squish”) when landing after the jump.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-land-scale-y
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s vertical distortion (“squish”) when landing after the jump.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-rebound
cssProperties.description: Set the amount of rebound an icon with `bounce` animation has when landing after the jump.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-start-scale-x
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s horizontal distortion (“squish”) when starting to bounce.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-start-scale-y
cssProperties.description: Set the icon’s vertical distortion (“squish”) when starting to bounce.

cssProperties.name: --fade-opacity
cssProperties.description: Set lowest opacity value an icon with `fade` animation will fade to and from.

cssProperties.name: --flip-angle
cssProperties.description: Set rotation angle of flip for an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation. A positive angle denotes a clockwise rotation, a negative angle a counter-clockwise one.

cssProperties.name: --flip-x
cssProperties.description: Set x-coordinate of the vector denoting the axis of rotation (between 0 and 1) for an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation.

cssProperties.name: --flip-y
cssProperties.description: Set y-coordinate of the vector denoting the axis of rotation (between 0 and 1) for an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation.

cssProperties.name: --flip-z
cssProperties.description: Set z-coordinate of the vector denoting the axis of rotation (between 0 and 1) for an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation.

cssProperties.name: --flip-anticipation-scale
cssProperties.description: Set the scale of the wind-up before an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation rotates.

cssProperties.name: --flip-overshoot
cssProperties.description: Set how far past the final angle an icon with `flip` or `flip-360` animation rotates before settling.

cssProperties.name: --bounce-anticipation
cssProperties.description: Set the downward squash distance before an icon with `bounce` animation jumps.

cssProperties.name: --buzz-distance
cssProperties.description: Set the horizontal travel of an icon with `buzz` animation.

cssProperties.name: --wag-angle
cssProperties.description: Set the peak rotation of an icon with `wag` animation.

cssProperties.name: --swing-angle
cssProperties.description: Set the peak rotation of an icon with `swing` animation.

cssProperties.name: --jello-scale-x
cssProperties.description: Set the horizontal stretch of an icon with `jello` animation.

cssProperties.name: --jello-scale-y
cssProperties.description: Set the vertical stretch of an icon with `jello` animation.

cssProperties.name: --float-height
cssProperties.description: Set the rise height of an icon with `float` animation.

cssProperties.name: --float-drift
cssProperties.description: Set the horizontal drift of an icon with `float` animation.

cssProperties.name: --float-tilt
cssProperties.description: Set the rotation of an icon with `float` animation.

cssProperties.name: --float-squash-x
cssProperties.description: Set the horizontal squash of an icon with `float` animation at rest.

cssProperties.name: --float-squash-y
cssProperties.description: Set the vertical squash of an icon with `float` animation at rest.

cssProperties.name: --float-stretch-x
cssProperties.description: Set the horizontal stretch of an icon with `float` animation at its peak.

cssProperties.name: --float-stretch-y
cssProperties.description: Set the vertical stretch of an icon with `float` animation at its peak.

cssProperties.name: --primary-color
cssProperties.description: Sets a duotone icon's primary color.

cssProperties.name: --primary-opacity
cssProperties.description: Sets a duotone icon's primary opacity.

cssProperties.name: --secondary-color
cssProperties.description: Sets a duotone icon's secondary color.

cssProperties.name: --secondary-opacity
cssProperties.description: Sets a duotone icon's secondary opacity.

cssParts.name: use
cssParts.description: The `<use>` element generated when using `spriteSheet: true`

components.name: WaAccordionItem
components.description: Accordion items are used inside `<wa-accordion>` to create expandable sections with accessible headers.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text label shown in the header. If you need HTML, use the `label` slot instead.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Expands the accordion item.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the accordion item so it can't be toggled.

slots.description: The accordion item's body content.

slots.name: label
slots.description: The accordion item's label. Alternatively, use the `label` attribute.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Optional expand/collapse icon. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

cssProperties.name: --spacing
cssProperties.description: The amount of space around and between the item's header and content.

cssProperties.name: --show-duration
cssProperties.description: The duration of the expand animation.

cssProperties.name: --hide-duration
cssProperties.description: The duration of the collapse animation.

cssProperties.name: --easing
cssProperties.description: The easing of the expand/collapse animation.

cssParts.name: heading
cssParts.description: The heading element wrapping the trigger button. Omitted when `heading-level="none"`.

cssParts.name: button
cssParts.description: The trigger button that toggles the panel.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the label.

cssParts.name: icon
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the expand/collapse icon.

cssParts.name: panel
cssParts.description: The panel that contains the item's content.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: The content slot inside the panel.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the accordion item with animation.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the accordion item with animation.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the accordion item's expanded state.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the accordion item's trigger button.

components.name: WaSpinner
components.description:
Spinners indicate that an operation is in progress when the duration is unknown. Use them for loading states
where a determinate progress bar isn't practical.

cssProperties.name: --track-width
cssProperties.description: The width of the track.

cssProperties.name: --track-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the track.

cssProperties.name: --indicator-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the spinner's indicator.

cssProperties.name: --speed
cssProperties.description: The time it takes for the spinner to complete one animation cycle.

components.name: WaStep
components.description: Steps represent a single stage inside a `<wa-stepper>`, showing its position, label, and status.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifies the step. Matched against the stepper's `active` attribute and used in events.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: Marks the step done. Shows a checkmark instead of the step number.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows a loading indicator instead of the step number, e.g. while an async transition is in progress.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description:
Makes the step non-interactive. It can't be clicked or reached with `next()`/`goTo()`, and it renders as a
disabled button when the stepper is `clickable`.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description:
Colors the step's marker with a semantic color. Upcoming `brand` steps keep a neutral outline so a default stepper
reads quietly. The color is cosmetic; pair it with an icon in the `icon` slot and a clear label when a step needs
to read as failed or flagged.

attributes.name: attention
attributes.description: Adds an animation to the step's marker to draw attention to it, e.g. the step the user should do next.

attributes.name: with-description
attributes.description:
Only required for SSR. Set to `true` if you're slotting in a `description` element, so the server-rendered
markup includes it before the component hydrates on the client.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description:
Draws the step as the stepper's current step. The parent `<wa-stepper>` sets this from its own `active`
attribute, so you only need to set it yourself for SSR.

slots.description: The step's label.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Optional text shown under the label.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, that replaces the step number, checkmark, or loading indicator.

cssProperties.name: --pulse-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the marker's pulse effect when using `attention="pulse"`. Defaults to the step's accent color.

cssParts.name: connector
cssParts.description: The line connecting this step to its neighbors. Each step draws the half leading in and the half leading out, and both carry this part name.

cssParts.name: button
cssParts.description: The `<button>` wrapping the marker and content. Only rendered when the parent stepper is `clickable`; otherwise the same wrapper is a plain, non-focusable element.

cssParts.name: marker
cssParts.description: The circular marker that shows the step's number, checkmark, or loading indicator.

cssParts.name: spinner
cssParts.description: The spinner shown in the marker while the step is `loading`.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: The wrapper around the label, status text, and description.

cssParts.name: status
cssParts.description: Visually hidden text that tells assistive technology whether the step is completed, not completed, or locked.

components.name: WaCheckbox
components.description:
Checkboxes let users toggle an option on or off, or select multiple items from a list. They also support an
indeterminate state for partial selections in groups.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the checkbox, submitted as a name/value pair with form data.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The checkbox's size.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the checkbox.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description:
Draws the checkbox in an indeterminate state. This is usually applied to checkboxes that represents a "select
all/none" behavior when associated checkboxes have a mix of checked and unchecked states.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: The default value of the form control. Primarily used for resetting the form control.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Makes the checkbox a required field.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: The checkbox's hint. If you need to display HTML, use the `hint` slot instead.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input, submitted as a name/value pair with form data.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the checked state changes.

events.name: blur
events.description: Emitted when the checkbox loses focus.

events.name: focus
events.description: Emitted when the checkbox gains focus.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when the checkbox receives input.

events.name: wa-invalid
events.description: Emitted when the form control has been checked for validity and its constraints aren't satisfied.

slots.description: The checkbox's label.

slots.name: hint
slots.description: Text that describes how to use the checkbox. Alternatively, you can use the `hint` attribute.

cssProperties.name: --checked-icon-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the checked and indeterminate icons.

cssProperties.name: --checked-icon-scale
cssProperties.description: The size of the checked and indeterminate icons relative to the checkbox.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The square container that wraps the checkbox's checked state.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the checkbox's label.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click on the checkbox.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus on the checkbox.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the checkbox.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description:
Do not use this when creating a "Validator". This is intended for end users of components.
We track manually defined custom errors so we don't clear them on accident in our validators.

methods.name: formStateRestoreCallback
methods.description:
Called when the browser is trying to restore element’s state to state in which case reason is "restore", or when
the browser is trying to fulfill autofill on behalf of user in which case reason is "autocomplete". In the case of
"restore", state is a string, File, or FormData object previously set as the second argument to setFormValue.

methods.name: resetValidity
methods.description: Reset validity is a way of removing manual custom errors and native validation.

components.name: WaTreeItem
components.description:
Tree items represent a single hierarchical node inside a tree, and can contain nested items that expand and
collapse.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Expands the tree item.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Draws the tree item in a selected state.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the tree item.

attributes.name: lazy
attributes.description: Enables lazy loading behavior.

events.name: wa-expand
events.description: Emitted when the tree item expands.

events.name: wa-after-expand
events.description: Emitted after the tree item expands and all animations are complete.

events.name: wa-collapse
events.description: Emitted when the tree item collapses.

events.name: wa-after-collapse
events.description: Emitted after the tree item collapses and all animations are complete.

events.name: wa-lazy-change
events.description: Emitted when the tree item's lazy state changes.

events.name: wa-lazy-load
events.description: Emitted when a lazy item is selected. Use this event to asynchronously load data and append items to the tree before expanding. After appending new items, remove the `lazy` attribute to remove the loading state and update the tree.

slots.description: The default slot.

slots.name: expand-icon
slots.description: The icon to show when the tree item is expanded.

slots.name: collapse-icon
slots.description: The icon to show when the tree item is collapsed.

cssProperties.name: --show-duration
cssProperties.description: The animation duration when expanding tree items.

cssProperties.name: --hide-duration
cssProperties.description: The animation duration when collapsing tree items.

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: The tree item's container. This element wraps everything except slotted tree item children.

cssParts.name: expand-button
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the tree item's expand button and spinner.

cssParts.name: spinner
cssParts.description: The spinner that shows when a lazy tree item is in the loading state.

cssParts.name: children
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the tree item's nested children.

cssParts.name: checkbox
cssParts.description: The checkbox that shows when using multiselect.

methods.name: getChildrenItems
methods.description: Gets all the nested tree items in this node.

components.name: WaCarouselItem
components.description: Carousel items represent individual slides within a carousel.

slots.description: The carousel item's content..

cssProperties.name: --aspect-ratio
cssProperties.description: The slide's aspect ratio. Inherited from the carousel by default.

components.name: WaAccordion
components.description: Accordions are a vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each contain a title, representing a section of content.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description:
Controls how items can be expanded. `multiple` (the default) allows any number of items to be open at
once. `single` allows only one item to be open at a time; opening a new item collapses the previously
open one, and clicking an open item does not collapse it. `single-collapsible` is the same as `single`
except that clicking the open item collapses it, so zero open items is a valid state.

attributes.name: icon-placement
attributes.description: The location of the expand/collapse icon in child items.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: The heading level for child item triggers (1–6), or "none" to omit the heading wrapper. Defaults to 3.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: The accordion's visual appearance.

events.name: wa-expand
events.description: Emitted before an item expands. Cancelable.

events.name: wa-after-expand
events.description: Emitted after an item finishes expanding.

events.name: wa-collapse
events.description: Emitted before an item collapses. Cancelable.

events.name: wa-after-collapse
events.description: Emitted after an item finishes collapsing.

slots.description: One or more `<wa-accordion-item>` elements.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expands all accordion items. No-op when `mode` is `single` or `single-collapsible`.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapses all accordion items.

components.name: WaAnimatedImage
components.description:
Animated images display GIFs and WEBPs with controls to play and pause them on demand. Use them when you
want motion but need to give users control over when it plays.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: The path to the image to load.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: A description of the image used by assistive devices.

attributes.name: play
attributes.description: Plays the animation. When this attribute is remove, the animation will pause.

events.name: wa-load
events.description: Emitted when the image loads successfully.

events.name: wa-error
events.description: Emitted when the image fails to load.

slots.name: play-icon
slots.description: Optional play icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

slots.name: pause-icon
slots.description: Optional pause icon to use instead of the default. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

cssProperties.name: --control-box-size
cssProperties.description: The size of the icon box.

cssProperties.name: --icon-size
cssProperties.description: The size of the play/pause icons.

cssParts.name: control-box
cssParts.description: The container that surrounds the pause/play icons and provides their background.

components.name: WaAnimation
components.description:
Animate elements declaratively with nearly 100 baked-in presets, or roll your own with custom keyframes.
Powered by the Web Animations API.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the built-in animation to use. For custom animations, use the `keyframes` prop.

attributes.name: play
attributes.description:
Plays the animation. When omitted, the animation will be paused. This attribute will be automatically removed when
the animation finishes or gets canceled.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: The number of milliseconds to delay the start of the animation.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description:
Determines the direction of playback as well as the behavior when reaching the end of an iteration.
[Learn more](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-direction)

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The number of milliseconds each iteration of the animation takes to complete.

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description:
The easing function to use for the animation. This can be a Web Awesome easing function or a custom easing function
such as `cubic-bezier(0, 1, .76, 1.14)`.

attributes.name: end-delay
attributes.description: The number of milliseconds to delay after the active period of an animation sequence.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Sets how the animation applies styles to its target before and after its execution.

attributes.name: iterations
attributes.description: The number of iterations to run before the animation completes. Defaults to `Infinity`, which loops.

attributes.name: iteration-start
attributes.description: The offset at which to start the animation, usually between 0 (start) and 1 (end).

attributes.name: playback-rate
attributes.description:
Sets the animation's playback rate. The default is `1`, which plays the animation at a normal speed. Setting this
to `2`, for example, will double the animation's speed. A negative value can be used to reverse the animation. This
value can be changed without causing the animation to restart.

events.name: wa-cancel
events.description: Emitted when the animation is canceled.

events.name: wa-finish
events.description: Emitted when the animation finishes.

events.name: wa-start
events.description: Emitted when the animation starts or restarts.

slots.description: The element to animate. Avoid slotting in more than one element, as subsequent ones will be ignored. To animate multiple elements, either wrap them in a single container or use multiple `<wa-animation>` elements.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clears all keyframe effects caused by this animation and aborts its playback.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Sets the playback time to the end of the animation corresponding to the current playback direction.

components.name: WaAvatar
components.description:
Avatars represent a person or object with an image, initials, or icon. Use them in lists, comments, and
profiles to give users visual context at a glance.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: The image source to use for the avatar.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: A label to use to describe the avatar to assistive devices.

attributes.name: initials
attributes.description: Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available (1-2 characters max recommended).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Indicates how the browser should load the image.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the avatar.

events.name: wa-error
events.description: The image could not be loaded. This may because of an invalid URL, a temporary network condition, or some unknown cause.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The default icon to use when no image or initials are present. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

cssProperties.name: --size
cssProperties.description: The size of the avatar.

cssParts.name: icon
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the avatar's icon.

cssParts.name: initials
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the avatar's initials.

cssParts.name: image
cssParts.description: The avatar image. Only shown when the `image` attribute is set.

components.name: WaBadge
components.description:
Badges draw attention to adjacent content by displaying a status, count, or label. Use them to highlight
notifications, categorize items, or flag new activity.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The badge's theme variant. Defaults to `brand` if not within another element with a variant.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: The badge's visual appearance.

attributes.name: pill
attributes.description: Draws a pill-style badge with rounded edges.

attributes.name: attention
attributes.description: Adds an animation to draw attention to the badge.

slots.description: The badge's content.

slots.name: start
slots.description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed before the label.

slots.name: end
slots.description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed after the label.

cssProperties.name: --pulse-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the badge's pulse effect when using `attention="pulse"`.

cssParts.name: start
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the `start` slot.

cssParts.name: end
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the `end` slot.

components.name: WaBreadcrumbItem
components.description:
Breadcrumb items represent individual links inside a breadcrumb, typically one per level of the site
hierarchy.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description:
Optional URL to direct the user to when the breadcrumb item is activated. When set, a link will be rendered
internally. When unset, a button will be rendered instead.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is set.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description: The `rel` attribute to use on the link. Only used when `href` is set.

slots.description: The breadcrumb item's label.

slots.name: start
slots.description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed before the label.

slots.name: end
slots.description: An element, such as `<wa-icon>`, placed after the label.

slots.name: separator
slots.description: The separator to use for the breadcrumb item. This will only change the separator for this item. If you want to change it for all items in the group, set the separator on `<wa-breadcrumb>` instead.

cssParts.name: start
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the `start` slot.

cssParts.name: end
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the `end` slot.

cssParts.name: separator
cssParts.description: The container that wraps the separator.

components.name: WaBreadcrumb
components.description:
Breadcrumbs display a trail of links that show users where they are in a site's hierarchy. They help users
understand the current location and navigate back to parent pages.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
The label to use for the breadcrumb control. This will not be shown on the screen, but it will be announced by
screen readers and other assistive devices to provide more context for users.

slots.description: One or more breadcrumb items to display.

slots.name: separator
slots.description: The separator to use between breadcrumb items. Works best with `<wa-icon>`.

components.name: WaButton
components.description:
Buttons represent actions the user can take, such as submitting a form, opening a dialog, or navigating to
another page.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The button's theme variant. Defaults to `neutral` if not within another element with a variant.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: The button's visual appearance.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The button's size.

attributes.name: with-caret
attributes.description: Draws the button with a caret. Used to indicate that the button triggers a dropdown menu or similar behavior.

attributes.name: with-start
attributes.description:
Only required for SSR. Set to `true` if you're slotting in a `start` element so the server-rendered markup
includes the start slot before the component hydrates on the client.

components.name: WaPopup
components.description:
Popups declaratively anchor one element to another and keep them positioned together as the page scrolls or
resizes. Primarily a low-level building block for popovers, dropdowns, and tooltips.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description:
The element the popup will be anchored to. If the anchor lives outside of the popup, you can provide the anchor
element `id`, a DOM element reference, or a `VirtualElement`. If the anchor lives inside the popup, use the
`anchor` slot instead.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description:
Activates the positioning logic and shows the popup. When this attribute is removed, the positioning logic is torn
down and the popup will be hidden.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description:
The preferred placement of the popup. Note that the actual placement will vary as configured to keep the
panel inside of the viewport.

attributes.name: boundary
attributes.description: The bounding box to use for flipping, shifting, and auto-sizing.

attributes.name: distance
attributes.description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the panel away from its anchor.

attributes.name: skidding
attributes.description: The distance in pixels from which to offset the panel along its anchor.

attributes.name: arrow
attributes.description:
Attaches an arrow to the popup. The arrow's size and color can be customized using the `--arrow-size` and
`--arrow-color` custom properties. For additional customizations, you can also target the arrow using
`::part(arrow)` in your stylesheet.

attributes.name: arrow-placement
attributes.description:
The placement of the arrow. The default is `anchor`, which will align the arrow as close to the center of the
anchor as possible, considering available space and `arrow-padding`. A value of `start`, `end`, or `center` will
align the arrow to the start, end, or center of the popover instead.

attributes.name: arrow-padding
attributes.description:
The amount of padding between the arrow and the edges of the popup. If the popup has a border-radius, for example,
this will prevent it from overflowing the corners.

attributes.name: flip
attributes.description:
When set, placement of the popup will flip to the opposite site to keep it in view. You can use
`flipFallbackPlacements` to further configure how the fallback placement is determined.

attributes.name: flip-fallback-placements
attributes.description:
If the preferred placement doesn't fit, popup will be tested in these fallback placements until one fits. Must be a
string of any number of placements separated by a space, e.g. "top bottom left". If no placement fits, the flip
fallback strategy will be used instead.

attributes.name: flip-fallback-strategy
attributes.description:
When neither the preferred placement nor the fallback placements fit, this value will be used to determine whether
the popup should be positioned using the best available fit based on available space or as it was initially
preferred.

attributes.name: flipBoundary
attributes.description:
The flip boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when flipping. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.

attributes.name: flip-padding
attributes.description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the flip behavior will occur.

attributes.name: shift
attributes.description: Moves the popup along the axis to keep it in view when clipped.

attributes.name: shiftBoundary
attributes.description:
The shift boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when shifting. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.

attributes.name: shift-padding
attributes.description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the shift behavior will occur.

attributes.name: auto-size
attributes.description: When set, this will cause the popup to automatically resize itself to prevent it from overflowing.

attributes.name: sync
attributes.description: Syncs the popup's width or height to that of the anchor element.

attributes.name: autoSizeBoundary
attributes.description:
The auto-size boundary describes clipping element(s) that overflow will be checked relative to when resizing. By
default, the boundary includes overflow ancestors that will cause the element to be clipped. If needed, you can
change the boundary by passing a reference to one or more elements to this property.

attributes.name: auto-size-padding
attributes.description: The amount of padding, in pixels, to exceed before the auto-size behavior will occur.

attributes.name: hover-bridge
attributes.description:
When a gap exists between the anchor and the popup element, this option will add a "hover bridge" that fills the
gap using an invisible element. This makes listening for events such as `mouseenter` and `mouseleave` more sane
because the pointer never technically leaves the element. The hover bridge will only be drawn when the popover is
active.

events.name: wa-reposition
events.description: Emitted when the popup is repositioned. This event can fire a lot, so avoid putting expensive operations in your listener or consider debouncing it.

slots.description: The popup's content.

slots.name: anchor
slots.description: The element the popup will be anchored to. If the anchor lives outside of the popup, you can use the `anchor` attribute or property instead.

cssProperties.name: --arrow-size
cssProperties.description: The size of the arrow. Note that an arrow won't be shown unless the `arrow` attribute is used.

cssProperties.name: --popup-border-width
cssProperties.description: The width of any custom border applied to the popup. This is used to reposition the arrow to overlap to the inside edge of the popup border.

cssProperties.name: --arrow-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the arrow.

cssProperties.name: --auto-size-available-width
cssProperties.description: A read-only custom property that determines the amount of width the popup can be before overflowing. Useful for positioning child elements that need to overflow. This property is only available when using `auto-size`.

cssProperties.name: --auto-size-available-height
cssProperties.description: A read-only custom property that determines the amount of height the popup can be before overflowing. Useful for positioning child elements that need to overflow. This property is only available when using `auto-size`.

cssProperties.name: --show-duration
cssProperties.description: The show duration to use when applying built-in animation classes.

cssProperties.name: --hide-duration

HSL, and HSV formats with optional alpha channel and swatch presets.

includes the label before the component hydrates on the client.

attributes.name: with-hint
attributes.description:

includes the hint before the component hydrates on the client.

display HTML, you can use the `label` slot` instead.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: The color picker's hint. If you need to display HTML, use the `hint` slot instead.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description:
The format to use. If opacity is enabled, these will translate to HEXA, RGBA, HSLA, and HSVA respectively. The color
picker will accept user input in any format (including CSS color names) and convert it to the desired format.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Determines the size of the color picker's trigger

attributes.name: placement

The preferred placement of the color picker's popup. Note that the actual placement will vary as configured to
keep the panel inside of the viewport.

attributes.name: without-format-toggle
attributes.description: Removes the button that lets users toggle between format.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the form control, submitted as a name/value pair with form data.

attributes.description: Disables the color picker.

attributes.description:
Indicates whether or not the popup is open. You can toggle this attribute to show and hide the popup, or you
can use the `show()` and `hide()` methods and this attribute will reflect the popup's open state.

attributes.name: opacity
attributes.description: Shows the opacity slider. Enabling this will cause the formatted value to be HEXA, RGBA, or HSLA.

attributes.name: uppercase
attributes.description: By default, values are lowercase. With this attribute, values will be uppercase instead.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description:
One or more predefined color swatches to display as presets in the color picker. Can include any format the color
picker can parse, including HEX(A), RGB(A), HSL(A), HSV(A), and CSS color names. Each color must be separated by a
semicolon (`;`). Alternatively, you can pass an array of color values or an array of `{ color, label }` objects to
this property using JavaScript. When using objects with labels, the label will be used for the swatch's accessible
name instead of the raw color value.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the color picker's value changes.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when the color picker receives input.
